root_cause: The query selects (SyncJob, Source.source_key) and returns SQLAlchemy Row pairs, but the comprehension iterated each Row as a single job object and accessed job.id. The Row has no id attribute.
proven_case: Pilot-start baseline id 471 had later scheduled jobs; SELECT returned (SyncJob, source_key) Row values; unpacking the pair restored SyncJob.id/status access.
classification: API response construction row/entity contract mismatch
